candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow check with `require(msg.value > 0);` so that zero-ETH sends are rejected while previously they incremented depositsCount.
Delete the `depositsCount++;` statement so that depositsCount never increments on receive.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2` so that each receive increments the count by two instead of one.
Remove the require statement so that the overflow check is skipped and depositsCount can wrap around.
Delete the body of withdrawAll so it does nothing, leaving the owner's ether stuck.
Replace the argument to withdraw with 0 so withdrawAll transfers no ether.
Replace the argument to withdraw with 1 wei so the transferred amount differs unless balance is 0 or 1.
Insert a call to sendMoney transferring 1 ether to a zero address before withdrawAll, reducing contract balance before withdrawal.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with sendMoney(msg.sender, address(this).balance), which uses call instead of transfer and may fail silently with no revert.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(true) so the onlyOwner check passes for anyone.
